sources.title: GitHub - samswede/HAC-RL: PyTorch implementation of Hierarchical Actor ...
sources.snippet: Hierarchical-Actor-Critic-HAC-PyTorch This is an implementation of the Hierarchical Actor Critic (HAC) algorithm described in the paper, Learning Multi-Level Hierarchies with Hindsight (ICLR 2019), in PyTorch for OpenAI gym environments. The algorithm learns to reach a goal state by dividing the task into short horizon intermediate goals (subgoals).

sources.title: Generative policy-driven HAC reinforcement learning for autonomous ...
sources.snippet: A novel generative policy-driven HAC framework is proposed, which seamlessly integrates discrete-time and continuous-time RL paradigms to effectively address the critical challenge of driving incident response in autonomous driving scenarios.This framework is designed to be compatible with most Actor-Critic algorithms, such as PPO and DDPG.
